thesis: Bill Gurley argues that the venture capital landscape is undergoing permanent changes driven by the rise of mega funds, the emergence of a thousand private companies valued over a billion dollars, and a significant increase in LP participation in private markets. He emphasizes that these shifts represent a system-level effect where aggregate market realities are disrupting previous assumptions about inherent cyclicality in the venture business.
